name: webkit2gtk-driver

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: WebKitGTK WebDriver executable used by scenario-to-desktop Linux journey automation
installHint: Install the approved WebKitGTK WebDriver package with `sudo vrooli setup`
privilegeReason: The approved WebKitGTK WebDriver package is installed through the operator-owned host setup flow.
notes: The package is host tooling and is not bundled into desktop applications. Host installation remains gated on operator setup.
